abort.already_configured: That thermostat is already set up.

error.auth_failed: That email/password was rejected by Micro-Air's sign-in service. Check it matches the app login and try again.
error.iot_connect_failed: Signed in, but the cloud connection to the thermostat service could not be established. Try again in a few minutes.
error.no_devices: Signed in fine, but this account lists no thermostats. Add the thermostat in the Micro-Air app first.
error.no_status_response: The cloud connection worked, but the thermostat itself did not answer. Make sure it is powered and on Wi-Fi, then try again.

device.description: Your account has more than one thermostat. Pick the one to add.
device.title: Choose your thermostat

user.description: Unofficial community integration — not made by Micro-Air. Sign in with the same email and password you use in the Micro-Air EasyTouch RV app. Setup tests the whole connection and only finishes if your thermostat answers.
user.title: Micro-Air account

init.title: Micro-Air EasyTouch (Cloud) settings
init.description:
Changes apply as soon as you save — no restart needed.

Need help with a problem? Turn on Debug logging below, then check Settings → System → Logs. For a one-time snapshot of the connection, close this dialog and use ⋮ → Download diagnostics on this integration's page.

Unofficial community integration — not made by, endorsed by, or affiliated with Micro-Air.

data_description.poll_interval_seconds: How often Home Assistant checks the thermostat for a fresh status. Choose 30–600 seconds (default: 60). Lower is fresher but talks to Micro-Air's cloud more often — 60 is right for most homes.
data_description.debug_logging: See Settings → System → Logs for this integration's detailed logging. Handy when reporting a problem; turn it back off when you're done. Home Assistant also has a built-in one-shot route — ⋮ menu → Enable debug logging on this integration's page, which downloads the log when you turn it back off. This switch instead keeps debug logging on until you turn it off.
